newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices regain initiative, new buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices regain initiative, new buying.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices bounced back on Monday from reduced levels to 1,181/1,182 rupees on fresh speculative buying, dealers said.

New crop arrivals as well as fears of lower new crops prompted renewed buying by bull operators, they said. Groundnut oil remained steady in the range of 343/345 rupees per 10 kg on limited arrivals of 60/70 tonnes coupled with sluggish offtake.
In Rajkot spot oil was steady at 525/530 rupees per 15 kg.
Increased purchases by the state-owned National Diary Development Board at the producing centres kept arrivals low in the Bombay Market, one miller said.
